transport: One simulation clock. 20ms captures. Constant 40ms delay in delay-40ms. Every third post-fault packet delayed 80ms in reordered. Gap suppresses delivery during [4.8,5.04); no catch-up. Stale-replay delivers the last pre-gap good packet until 5.2. gap-and-drop also opens the gripper during [4.8,5.04).
recovery: Hold retains actuator targets; physics continues. Gate and path factors are independent. Receipt resumes on any valid received packet including stale/duplicate. Revalidate requires unique ordered post-hold captures, each accepted at age<60ms, bilateral contact, cube_z>0.12m, grasp_error<0.05m, capture span>=100ms and gaps<=20ms; latest packet is fresh at resume. Deadline600ms wins. Wallclock resumes original absolute-time schedule; replan regenerates transfer1.5s from current measured grip pose followed by original lower/release/retreat/settle. Latched never resumes.
hypothesis: Factorial comparison of recovery evidence and remaining-path regeneration. Replanning includes retiming, not geometry alone.
scope: 30 deterministic cells; no randomization, clock skew, ROS2, vision, learned policy or regrasp. Hypothesis support is separate from artifact validity.
hand_speed_definition: Euclidean norm of 2ms finite difference of measured grip_center world position
